text.tspan: Mingfeng's species is completely original, and is based on that of a Chinese dragon.
I will get to his backstory in a bit, but for now, I also wanted to add that in his village, in Tengenui (don't be fooled by his name, he's not from China)
he's a warrior, like also a cop in his free time that makes sure the rest of the villagers (not the stupidly annoying ones in Minecraft or the ones in
Animal Crossing) stay out of trouble.
Example Assets (optional, you may attach more sprites/costumes if necessary)
